name: AiAdvertising, Inc.
summary: AiAdvertising, Inc. provides digital advertising solutions worldwide. The company develops solutions that help clients to acquire, engage, and retain their customers by leveraging digital strategies and artificial intelligence using data analytics solution. It focuses on design for branding, photography, copyrighting, printing, signs, and interior design; website coding development services; digital marketing for ad spend, SEO management, and digital ad support; and platform licensing services. The company was formerly known as CloudCommerce, Inc. and changed its name to AiAdvertising, Inc. in August 2021. AiAdvertising, Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas.
